dedupe_keys.name: instance data and computational results for rendezvous based relief delivery on road networks with vehicle dependent accessibility

description: Dexin Kong publishes road-network instances and computational results for a rendezvous-based relief-delivery study. Zenodo provides network and result ZIP files under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The description says generated cases include demand, vehicle and transport-mode attributes, route accessibility and an underlying road network derived from OpenStreetMap. A modeller can use these cases to benchmark emergency logistics simulation and routing when different vehicles can traverse different links. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this vehicle-dependent relief-delivery test set. A limitation is that the authors did not include solver source code and say it may follow publication. The page does not specify locations, instance counts or the exact accessibility restrictions, so a new algorithm needs file-level inspection before a fair comparison. Neither ZIP was downloaded, and travel costs or published objective values were not reproduced.
